spec.description: Session alive and authenticated. Offline is a real state, not a broken exporter — it keeps serving and reconnects on its own.
spec.title: Device

spec.description: Share of the selected time range the exporter was talking to the device.
spec.title: Availability

spec.description: Highest limiter state reached during the window, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp. Reads UNUSED when the loaded preset does not drive this band.
spec.title: LOW LIMITER

spec.description: Age of the newest value pushed by the device. A healthy PA2 pushes meters continuously, so a growing number means a stalled session.
spec.title: Last update

spec.description: Sessions lost in the selected range. Steady growth points at a flaky network path rather than a dead device.
spec.title: Reconnects

spec.description: Device instance name and firmware version.
spec.title: Firmware

spec.description: Peak, average and floor per channel within each rolling window, so transients between scrapes are not lost. The shaded band is the dynamic range seen. Left and right should track each other — a persistent gap between the two averages is a fault upstream, not a mix decision.
spec.title: Input level

spec.description: Post-mute output level for this crossover band. Drops to the -120 dB floor when the band is muted.
spec.title: Output level · LOW

spec.description: Post-mute output level for this crossover band. Drops to the -120 dB floor when the band is muted.
spec.title: Output level · MID

spec.description: Mean limiter threshold state across each rolling window, per band. 0 is clear of the threshold, 1 is sitting at the knee, 2 is limiting. A band that spends the evening near 1 is being asked for everything it has.
spec.title: Limiter activity

spec.description: Pre-mute limiter state per band, so it reports even while the outputs are muted.
spec.title: Limiter threshold state

spec.description: Bus compressor threshold state across the rolling window. Flat at zero whenever the compressor is switched off.
spec.title: Compressor activity

spec.description: Highest limiter state reached during the window, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp. Reads UNUSED when the loaded preset does not drive this band.
spec.title: MID LIMITER

spec.description: Clip events at the inputs. Anything above zero means somebody upstream is sending too much level.
spec.title: Input clips

spec.description: Mute state per output. Gaps mean the exporter lost the device — stale state is deliberately not drawn.
spec.title: Output mutes

spec.description: Per-output gain trim currently stored in the preset.
spec.title: Output trim

spec.description: Active feedback-suppression filters. A climbing count during a show usually means a mic is on the edge of ringing.
spec.title: Feedback suppression

spec.description: Audit trail of tweaks made at the front panel or from the control app, grouped by module.
spec.title: Settings changed on the device

spec.description: Total edits per module across the selected range.
spec.title: Changes in range

spec.description: Preset recalls in the selected range. Each one is also marked as an annotation on the time series above.
spec.title: Preset recalls

spec.description: Post-mute output level for this crossover band. Drops to the -120 dB floor when the band is muted.
spec.title: Output level · HIGH

spec.description: Hottest input peak anywhere in the selected range. Approaching 0 dB means there is no headroom left before the converters clip.
spec.title: Peak input

spec.description: Highest limiter state reached during the window, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp. Reads UNUSED when the loaded preset does not drive this band.
spec.title: HIGH LIMITER

spec.description: Furthest any band's limiter got in the selected range. LIMIT means the system was driven past its headroom at some point tonight.
spec.title: Limiter peak

spec.description: Clip events across both inputs in the selected range. Anything above zero means somebody upstream is sending too much level.
spec.title: Input clips

spec.description: Whether anything is currently muted. PARTIAL usually means a band was left muted after soundcheck.
spec.title: Outputs

spec.description: Peak input level per channel within the rolling window — the closest equivalent to the hardware's input meters.
spec.title: INPUT

spec.description: Preset currently recalled on the device.
spec.title: PRESET

spec.description: Lights when the preset has been edited but not stored — the state the hardware's STORE lamp warns about.
spec.title: STORE

spec.description: Post-mute output level per band and channel. Muted outputs sit at the bottom of the scale, as they do on the hardware.
spec.title: OUTPUT

spec.description: Mute state for this output.
spec.title: L
